description: This file defines the `EmailSubscriptionAPI` class, which handles REST API endpoints related to email subscriptions within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for listing all email subscriptions, updating a specific subscription's enabled status, and placeholders for create, delete, and retrieve single subscription operations, adhering to a CRUD interface. The class also contains annotations for API documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger).

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionAPI
classes.description: API class for managing email subscription entities, providing endpoints for listing, updating, and placeholders for creating, deleting, and retrieving subscriptions within the OrangeHRM system.
